name: Mirror
description:
## Description

"Double cone type 20cm full range speaker unit.The low-frequency diaphragm uses a metal-clad diaphragm composed of aluminum light alloy foils and styrene foam. This diaphragm is ten times stronger and more efficient than paper cone.In addition, a light metal diaphragm is used for the high frequency range.The voice coil uses a 52mm diameter size.The edge uses a half-round roll edge made of cloth treated with synthetic resin.Yoke cover is not provided in consideration of resonance and effect on the volume inside the enclosure."
